question: Which edition of the ASEAN Defence Ministers’ Meeting (ADMM)-Plus Experts Working Group on Counter Terrorism was held in New Delhi in January 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**16th.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 16th ADMM-Plus Experts Working Group on Counter Terrorism and Final Planning Conference for Table Top Exercise is being held in New Delhi from January 14 to 16, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **This meeting is the 16th edition of the ADMM-Plus Experts Working Group on Counter Terrorism.**
 
• India and Malaysia are co-chairing the EWG on Counter Terrorism.
 
• Delegations from ASEAN member states and dialogue partners are participating in the meeting.
 
• The meeting is part of the 2024–2027 three-year cooperation cycle under ADMM-Plus.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ADMM-Plus__

 __
 
• A platform for defence cooperation between ASEAN and its dialogue partners
 
• Focuses on seven areas including counter-terrorism, maritime security and cyber security
 
 
 
• Experts Working Group__
 __
 
• Specialised groups created to implement practical cooperation in specific focus areas
 
• Each EWG operates in a three-year cycle with meetings and exercises
 
 
 
• Table Top Exercise__
 __
 
• A discussion-based exercise to test planning and coordination
 
• Used to prepare for real-world operational cooperation
 
 
 
• Field Training Exercise__
 
 
• A live exercise planned to be conducted by India in 2027
 
• Tests the operational readiness and coordination of participating countries
